With the linear regularizer evaluated only at observed timestamps, smooth perturbations that vanish at those timestamps leave the objective unchanged. The claim of performance 'on par' with state-of-the-art single-cell methods is overstated. OT-MFM has lower mean EMD in all seven settings in Tables 1–2. The proposed explanation involving 'pointwise metrics' is inappropriate because EMD compares distributions.

Manual registration also uses the held-out sections' H&E images, so the information available when predicting an 'unobserved' section needs clarification.
